title: FFA State Officers
before:
The Maine FFA Association is a student-run organization directed by a team of student state FFA officers with support from the Maine FFA Association and FFA Liaison.

The state FFA officers of the Maine FFA Association have demonstrated a superior level of commitment to Maine FFA, as well as to agriculture and natural resources. All officers have participated in high-quality leadership training to prepare them for their year of service. During that year, the officers conduct FFA presentations in classrooms, develop and deliver student leadership workshops, represent the Maine FFA and agricultural education at state- and national-level events, and prepare and present the annual State FFA Convention at the University of Maine. During the convention, student FFA members are able to participate in competitive events, tours, and award sessions, receiving recognition for their accomplishments.

Here is the contact information for the 2026-2027 Maine FFA state officers:

  • Madison Brazier, Maine FFA State President (mbraziermeffa@gmail.com)
  • Wyatt Manning-Harris, Maine FFA State Vice President (wmanningharrismeffa@gmail.com)
  • Cassidy Rafford, Maine FFA State Treasurer (craffordmeffa@gmail.com)
  • Helen Rice, Maine FFA State Secretary (hricemeffa@gmail.com)

We thank our past state officers for their years of service. To learn more about Maine's past state officers, please visit Past State Officers.

If you are interested in becoming a state officer, please refer to Forms & Resources for applications and a question bank for the exam. If you would like to request a classroom visit or have a State Officer attend an event, please complete the State Officer Request Form.

Contact

Emily Doughty
Education Specialist, CTE Resource Specialist, Maine FFA State Liaison
Phone: 207-592-0314
Email: Emily.Doughty@maine.gov
